scope: Independent visual review of only the three reference pairs in reference-13.input.json.

identity_checks.case_metadata_identity: All three case sidecars match the requested case ID, round 1, run ID, binary SHA256, and source SHA256.
identity_checks.candidate_png_identity: Get-FileHash SHA256 of each unmodified candidate PNG matches its case evidence_hashes.screenshot.sha256.
identity_checks.reference_png_identity: Get-FileHash SHA256 of each unmodified reference PNG matches its case reference_sha256.
identity_checks.comparison_scale: Candidate native captures are 618 x 824 logical pixels at 1x; references are 1236 x 1648 physical pixels at 2x. Geometry was compared at the same logical scale.

observations: The secondary catalog has a labeled back action and distinct search, filter, and source-settings icons. There is no dock.

All five catalog rows are visible. Covers are approximately 64 x 88 logical pixels, rows follow approximately 108-pixel spacing, and the cover/text columns and separators align closely with the reference at half physical scale.
The source heading and book titles retain a bold serif hierarchy; authors, genres, and status lines remain gray and readable without clipping or collisions with the library badges.
The page folio and next-page action remain fully visible below the fifth row. The white background, thin separators, and outlined surfaces have no added shadows or stippled backdrop.
intentional_differences: The source subtitle contains its actual language/version summary without the reference's appended total-count phrase. The real catalog count is still represented by the page range, and this shorter data summary does not disturb the header geometry.
Native 1x rasterization differs from the physical 2x reference at individual glyph and cover-pattern pixels; no geometric defect is inferred from that sampling difference.

observations: The filter sheet is a white surface with a black top border, a title and Reset action, sorting, publication-status controls, neutral tag chips, and a full-width results action.

Four sorting choices occupy the same four-column logical layout as the reference. The selected sort is black with white text, enabled alternatives have dark outlines, and disabled choices are visibly gray.
The four publication-status choices fit on one row, and all nine real tag choices fit across two rows without clipping. The results action is fully inside the 618 x 824 viewport with readable text.
The sheet top is near logical y=366, compared with about y=370 in the reference. Content-dependent sheet height is allowed; the small top-edge difference does not cause crowding or lost controls.
The visible tags are neutral, consistent with catalog_tag_options state=0 in the sidecar. This still image alone does not demonstrate the include/exclude transitions.
No shadow, stippled scrim, clipped text, or button overlap is visible. The underlying catalog remains readable above the sheet.
intentional_differences: The candidate uses its source-derived tag set and publication-status wording instead of copying the reference's sample choices.
Follow and Rating sorting are disabled in both the visible controls and the case state. Their gray styling is accepted as actual capability feedback.

The results action describes the 128 loaded books rather than the reference's approximate result count. The active filter icon also receives a black selection background. These differences do not obstruct the controls.

observations: The reference presents a source-settings sheet with a heading and Done action. The candidate presents the unchanged full catalog, with no settings surface, empty-state message, or visible close action.

The candidate PNG is byte-identical to pw-source--default. Its case state nevertheless records modal=choices and modal_context=source-settings, so the recorded settings state has no visible representation.

The real source_preference_groups array is empty. This supports omitting the reference's particular language and image-quality controls, but the settings action still needs visible feedback for that empty declaration.
The underlying catalog remains geometrically sound and unclipped. The finding concerns the complete absence of a settings surface, not a content-dependent sheet height or top-edge position.
intentional_differences: No preferences are declared for the selected real source in this capture; the reference's specific language and quality options must not be fabricated merely to reproduce the sample content.

suggestions.description: Opening source settings for a source with no declared preferences produces no visible settings state or empty-state feedback.
suggestions.evidence: The settings candidate is visibly identical to the default catalog and has the same unmodified-PNG SHA256, 9982eafb3a4c363c2d57dcc72e042e16912421235462dcbc0ea9282a7bcb6a2f. The settings case sidecar records modal=choices, modal_context=source-settings, and source_preference_groups=[]. Unlike the reference's visible sheet, the candidate has no heading, explanation, or Done/Close control.
suggestions.recommendation: Render a white outlined source-settings sheet with the actual source title, a clear message that this source exposes no preferences, and a reachable Done/Close action when the declaration is empty. Continue to render only genuine source-declared common form controls when preferences exist.

limitations: Only the three listed pairs and their existing JSON sidecars were reviewed. No conclusion is made about the rest of the round.
All six original PNGs were individually opened with tools.view_image. Hashes describe their unmodified on-disk bytes; no image was resized, recaptured, or edited for this review.
This was a static evidence review. No local application, build, tests, validation suite, runtime probe, Git operation, or product modification was performed.

Control reachability is assessed from visible placement and recorded state only. Tag include/exclude transitions, persistence, dismissal behavior, and network-backed source preference discovery were not exercised.
The reference bundle identifier is supplied review context. Individual reference PNG hashes were independently compared with each case sidecar; the complete reference bundle was not rehashed.
